title: Composition-Level Prioritization of Lithium-Ion Cathode Candidates: code and data
description:
Analysis code, processed data, fitted CatBoost surrogate and numerical outputs for the study Composition-Level Prioritization of Lithium-Ion Cathode Candidates (Wang, Millner, Wang, Zhou and Chen; manuscript submitted).

The package contains the composition-aware data pipeline (canonical composition identities, cross-validation folds, composition and test-context features), model validation from record-level to composition-, context- and family-level holdout, the matched 20-seed elitist NSGA-II and random search with all saved candidate pools and TopK tables, the G1–G4 chemistry screens with positive-control calibration, candidate recurrence, uncertainty analyses, and Figures 1–5 with their source tables. The folder revision_analyses/ adds the scripts and output tables of the additional analyses carried out after submission (strict redox budgets, counterpart compositions, random-forest re-ranking, literature comparisons, valence-dependent G3, test-condition curves, model-seed robustness and others).

Licences: source code under MIT (LICENSE); data, model and result files under CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE-DATA). The capacity records were built from the battery materials database of Huang and Cole (Scientific Data 7, 260, 2020; Figshare doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.11888115.v2; CC BY 4.0), which must be cited together with this record.
